title: Miami Beach Ultimate City Bike Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready to ride through the heart of paradise on Bobby’s Bike Hike’s Ultimate City Miami Beach Bike Tour—a gorgeous 10 mile(16 km) journey designed for ages 10+ that brings Miami’s culture, history, & coastal beauty to life on two wheels. As America’s 1st city bike tour operator, Bobby’s blends top-rated storytelling with smooth, scenic cruising for an experience unlike any other.

Led by expert local guides, you’ll uncover the stories of Miami Beach from its ancient tribal roots to its glamorous rise as a cultural hotspot. Glide under swaying palm trees, past turquoise waves, & through neighborhoods packed with personality. Along the way, marvel at the world’s largest Art Deco district, cruise past the iconic Versace Mansion, &—seasonally from November to April—pedal across the bridge to gawk at the celebrity mansions of Star Island.

This Bike Tour in Miami is more than a ride—it’s a deep dive into the soul of South Beach. Sun & stories come together for an unforgettable adventure.
